title: The Hyksos rule in Egypt
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Taking Africa for Jesus). Dated only by the Generations books cited below; no tier 1–4 chronology covers this event.

sorting_basis.note: PROVISIONAL: no CFAH, Ussher–Jones or Ussher date exists, so the sort uses Generations (Taking Africa for Jesus, PDF p. 29): about 1700 to 1600 BC. Pending owner decision (open question A8).

chronologies.note: The Hyksos (Amalekite) period lasts 428 years from the Exodus until Ahmose I defeats Khamudi.
